name: Fabric Real-Time Intelligence
short_description: The Microsoft Fabric workload for streaming and event data, combining eventstreams, eventhouses with KQL databases, real-time dashboards and Activator alerts.

evidence.quote: Microsoft fabric real-time intelligence can play a strong role in the middle of this pipeline
What exactly is real-time intelligence in Microsoft Fabric?
It's a set of tools inside Microsoft Fabric that lets you bring in data, process it, analyze it
